titulo: NASA’s DAVINCI Probe Can Stand the Heat
cuerpo: The engineering development unit for NASA’s DAVINCI (Deep Atmosphere Venus Investigation of Noble gases, Chemistry, and Imaging) probe is photographed prior to a major thermal evaluation.
